summarizer.system_prompt: You are a concise technical writer. Provide clear, structured answers. Keep responses under 200 words unless asked otherwise.

assistant.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. When you have tools available, use them to answer questions accurately. Always show your work.

reviewer_a.system_prompt: You are a security-focused code reviewer. Look for vulnerabilities, injection risks, unsafe recursion, and resource exhaustion. End your review with exactly: VERDICT: APPROVED or VERDICT: NEEDS_WORK

reviewer_b.system_prompt: You are a performance-focused code reviewer. Look for algorithmic inefficiency, unnecessary allocations, O(n^2) patterns, and missing memoization. End your review with exactly: VERDICT: APPROVED or VERDICT: NEEDS_WORK

drafter.system_prompt: You are a technical writer. Write clearly and concisely. Keep responses under 150 words.

editor.system_prompt: You are a technical editor. Refine the draft for clarity and conciseness. Keep it under 150 words.

judge.system_prompt: You are an API design reviewer. Evaluate proposals for security, usability, and operational readiness. End your review with exactly one of: VERDICT: APPROVED, VERDICT: REVIEW, or VERDICT: REJECTED

security.rationale: Demos need filesystem access for telemetry and report output

filesystem.rationale: Demos write telemetry and governance reports to the demo directory

network.rationale: Agent API calls require outbound network access

shell.rationale: Demo 06 uses codegen.run_strict() which requires subprocess execution

codegen.rationale: Demo 06 uses codegen.run_strict() for agent-generated code execution

deep_nesting.rationale: Avoid deeply nested logic in demos

empty_catch.rationale: Errors must not be silently swallowed

scoring.rationale: Show risk scoring in dashboard output

context_drift.rationale: Enable CDD coherence tracking for pipeline and multi-turn demos

execution.rationale: Multi-agent demos with API calls need generous timeouts
